Editorial Policy

Guides are written to answer a specific question and are checked against official sources such as park, venue and city websites. Prices, hours and schedules change, so confirm with the source before you go. We separate confirmed facts from estimates and never present unverified details as certain. We do not claim first-hand visits unless they happened.

Houston Local Guide is an independent guide and is not affiliated with the City of Houston or any business.
